name: Orange County, VA
findings: Orange County has 85 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Orange County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Orange County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Orange County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
